frontmatter.description: Reverse engineer, debloat, de-ad, patch, or re-sign Android APKs, and analyze their runtime and server-side behaviour. Use for an .apk/.aab/.dex/.so sample, smali or dex patching, Frida hooking, repacking, ad or SDK removal, API probing, or deciding whether a client-side patch can work. Covers recon, anti-tamper, membership limits, surgical dex patching, repack pitfalls, device setup, and a failure catalogue.
frontmatter.license: MIT — see LICENSE at the repository root
frontmatter.compatibility: Python 3.9+. Device work needs adb; dynamic analysis a matching frida-server; re-signing zipalign plus apksigner, not just a JVM. Static dex/ELF work and the leak scanner are offline. Run doctor.py --json for status.
